why_cohort_rebuild_first: The bucket cohort MTs were chr22-ONLY (Gate C smoke overwrote the production mt_{ancestry}_qc.mt paths; final checkpoint is not interval-isolated). AOU-2 (LD) reads them directly and dev-10/production regions span all autosomes -> LD would skip every region. So cohorts had to be rebuilt genome-wide first. THIS run is that rebuild — the first full-scale run of the now-fixed pipeline (m3-W1 was the FAILED genome-wide attempt; Gate C proved the fixes on chr22).

live_session_gotchas.what: The Spark_20260604 saved cluster config injected a stale placeholder gs://cloned-mybucket-wb-perky-corn-6639 (404, never existed) into the terminal env. The Jupyter kernel had WORKSPACE_BUCKET UNSET (None). Diagnosed Row-1: ONLY WORKSPACE_BUCKET polluted; project (wb-perky-corn-6639), UFID (aou-rw-476cdac2), CDR (vwb-silky-artichoke-2408.C2024Q3R8 = v8), and all WGS_* paths (gs://vwb-aou-datasets-controlled/v8) correct; cluster SA has full read+write+delete on the REAL bucket; placeholder 404s (no shadow data).
live_session_gotchas.fix_applied_operationally: Manual Cell 1a guard `os.environ['WORKSPACE_BUCKET']='gs://rw-migration-aou-rw-476cdac2'` (fires on None or placeholder) + terminal `export WORKSPACE_BUCKET=gs://rw-migration-aou-rw-476cdac2`. Verified: Cell 1a printed `[bucket-guard] overriding None -> gs://rw-migration-aou-rw-476cdac2`. Resolution is call-time (aou_ld_panel.py:1436/1257 os.environ.get) and driver-only (executors receive fully-resolved gs:// paths), so the driver override covers all checkpoint writes.
live_session_gotchas.CRITICAL_for_refire: This guard is a MANUAL live-notebook edit, NOT in the repo. If the kernel/notebook is lost and AOU-1 must be re-run from a fresh clone, RE-APPLY the override (set WORKSPACE_BUCKET to gs://rw-migration-aou-rw-476cdac2) BEFORE Run All, or it writes to a 404 placeholder.
live_session_gotchas.durable_followup: Bake the guard into repo Cell 1a via /gsd-quick + regression note. See [[feedback_aou_cluster_template_bucket_pollution]].

live_session_gotchas.what: A clean/smudge filter (source of the MissingIDFieldWarning spam — adds missing cell `id` fields) re-dirties the 3 AOU notebooks on every git op, so `git checkout -- <files>` can never produce a clean tree. The cluster's pre-existing clone was on main @ 50f071c with those 3 notebooks dirty; checkout to m3-W2-aou-deltas kept aborting.
live_session_gotchas.fix_applied_operationally: `git checkout -f m3-W2-aou-deltas` (discards working-tree churn AND switches atomically, no window for the filter to re-dirty) -> landed 997461b. Diffs were pre-confirmed non-source (pure output/metadata churn). Untracked files preserved.
live_session_gotchas.durable_followup: cat .gitattributes / .git/hooks to document the filter; note checkout -f as the standard fix for fresh AoU clones.
